nom: KONEUK 14 Pack Sheet Face Masks Skincare

avis.titre: Nourishing variety pack for at-home spa nights
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised by this value-packed set of sheet masks. The 14 individual masks feature a variety of natural ingredients like aloe, pomegranate, honey and chamomile, making each self-care session unique. Each mask is loaded with hydrating essence that leaves my skin feeling soft, supple and refreshed, particularly when my complexion feels dry or tired. I love that they fit nicely and stay put, and the scents are light and soothing. With so many masks to choose from it feels like a luxurious spa experience from the comfort of home, and the price is fantastic for the quantity included.

avis.titre: Hydrating masks but results are lightHydrating masks but results are light
avis.texte: I have been using these sheet masks for a few days and they feel very refreshing on the skin. They are easy to use and the packaging is nice. What I liked: they leave my skin feeling soft and hydrated right after use. The masks have a pleasant scent and are relaxing. What I didn’t like: the results do not last very long, and I did not see a big difference after multiple uses. Also, the mask can feel a little slippery. Good size and value for the money. Overall, these are good for a quick hydration boost, but not for long-term results. I hope this review helps.

avis.titre: A self care must haveA self care must have
avis.texte: I've ordered similar sheet mask packs in the past that I adored, but these are much better quality. These come with a plastic form inside the mask so you dont risk tearing the mask when you pull it apart. You get a wide variety of "essences" but I mainly like them because of the collagen. This is such a great deal, you won't find this many masks for this price with this quality. My skin looks and feels plump and moisturized. These would be great as gifts for a sleepover party.

I love these so much!! I love the variety, I love how soft my skin feels after application, I love the soft scents, I love the moisturizers in them!! When I use each mask, I save the wrapper with the extra product left, and I apply it as much as I want - great value for what I spent!

I was looking for a setting spray of face masks so I could have spa days at home. When I found this I was excited at the price and quantity. The package arrived quickly and free of damages. It has a huge assortment of masks to choose from. So far the masks smell great and feel amazing. These are loaded with tons of product on the cotton masks so you get your moneys worth. As the serum melts into your skin it leaves you feeling refreshed and moisturized. My pores appear smaller and hydrated. None of the masks have been dried out and all are consistently saturated in product. 10/10 will be ordering once I run out.
I love these masks. They make my skin feel so good. Could be longer lasting but i do really like them and love the variety.

Used the first one tonight and it’s lovely. Slight scent, healthy and clean, not too heavy. Very cooling. Each mask is loaded with essence and leaves the skin hydrated. Definitely recommend and will repurchase.

I love these! Perfect for my self care Sundays, I love that each one is a different with different beneficial things for your skin, you get a variety & you know exactly what to expect from each mask before even applying it from right on the packaging. I’ve only tried two so far but am already happy with the results after use, I will definitely be purchasing again

I used this on my wedding day. It made me glow! The skin look is the face mask + setting powder and blush. I don't use the masks often because I tend to get pimples the next day. It's probably because I never do moisturizer in the summer, just soap for my greasy face. Moisturizer is a winter activity for me. Could have invested in teeth whitening lol.

I got what I needed for my gifts and they were perfect size. The only reason why I gave it 4 stars is because the box was opened and look like it was opened before packaging. I counted to make sure all of the products was there and nothing missing or opened for the individual mask.

These are the best masks I have ever purchased so far. The masks are large enough to cover the face, there is plenty of product on the masks, and this variety pack has a wonder variety of scents. I will order again and highly recommend!

I use this almost daily. Very relaxing and hydrating. It doesn’t make me breakout at all. I didn't smell any fragrance. I am not sure if it makes any difference in my skin but it helps adding serum before I moisturize.

I use these for 8-10 minutes, twice a week, and I do not rinse it off. I am always soft and smooth! I squeeze the excess liquid out of the packet and mix it with some lotion for my neck and shoulders, too.

Me gustó mucho este set de mascarillas faciales. Vienen bien empacadas y la caja trae varias opciones, lo cual es perfecto para usarlas durante la semana. La mascarilla es muy hidratante y deja la piel suave después de usarla. Me gustó que tiene buena cantidad de esencia y no irrita la piel. Después de usarla sentí la piel fresca y más humectada. Me parece una buena opción para incluir en la rutina de cuidado facial en casa.

I keep going back these mask, they are fantastic value for money. But you can get lots of cheap sheet masks out there. I like this one because it’s effective, it leaves my skin soft with all most a glow. I do a sheet mask every day before my tret. As I really like the hydration. I also like the way it fits my face over other ones. It also comes in a box to keep them nice and neat.

I was making volleyball goodie bags for my daughter's varsity team as a fun way to kick off the season, and thought, "Who doesn't love a face mask?!?" These came very quickly and well packaged. I live in a VERY hot climate and was a little worried they might leak due to weather, but they all arrived in perfect condition. I love that there is such a variety. I was pleased that each girl was able to get a different kind of mask. Only thing I would change is I thought that tomato is an odd choice for face mask, and would have rather had more of another type, Other than that. They were great for the price. AND I have lots of left overs for last min gifts. Win/Win.

I have sensitive skin and these are so gentle on my skin. The masks are durable yet delicate not too thick at all. They also smell really good. My skin feels the different benefits from each one. People always tell me how great my skin looks since I have used them. All my girls love them. I will be buying these until I die. Definitely worth the money 56 collagen enriched mask for $25 is a steal.

I love it. I use one every single day before I do my make up and my skin is amazing. I’ve never had problems with my skin, but I do wear heavy makeup everyday and this gives me a peace of mind that I’m taking good care of my skin and it’s very cooling And I love the way it makes my skin feel. they all smell good and are very moistened. the quality is amazing, and I love the way to makes my and my makeup goes on better

i bought it for my mom’s birthday gift! she loved them!! she said they really helped brighten her face in the morning, helped hydrate her face, smelled superrrr good, and made her feel super relaxed. it was super effective in filling up a good percentage of my gift basket.
This is really a great purchase, it has a variety of sheet masks. I tried it right away and it’s worth it.
These masks help soften my skin and moistures it. Can be used anytime of the day I love the variety of the masks and different scents!!!!!!!!
They were nice flavors, however, these were not facial masks. They went on my face like water. I wouldn't recommend them. There's also no smell to them.

I felt a burning sensation immediately. I rinsed off & tried a different one just to see if it was that particular scent. The 2nd one burned too. I inspected the packaging and noticed both the manufacturer and distributor listed are Chinese instead of Korean. I have never experienced any burns from sheet masks until this. The sheet masks touched my upper lip and I can still feel a tingling burn after washing.
This brand between price and quantity balance consider cheap but good choice and when we use made our skin more moist and comfortable to use during busy activities

Do not use if you have sensitive skin , or maybe not at all. I bought these for a slumber party and had a few extra so I did them with the girls. I had a horrible allergic reaction/ maybe chemical burn. It I he’s and hurts at the same time. My niece used one and took it off right away said it burns. I have added pictures this is after Benadryl and prescription steroid cream.
Me encantó la textura, el olor y como deja la piel, súper recomendado.

avis.titre: BE AWARE- CAN CAUSE INFLAMMATION, Chemical Burn!
avis.texte: BE AWARE!! Purchased these masks for the first time and gave as gifts. Thankfully I was the only one to use them. In less than 24 hours of using the Aloe mask, my face began to itch. Went to bed and woke up the next day with a swollen face, onset of a rash and one eye swollen almost shut. Tried over the counter methods, but they didn’t work. Went to bed, woke up on day two and rash had increased, left eye now swollen and face on fire. An outline of the mask can be seen on my face, particularly the forehead area. I’ve used many masks (different brands) and have NEVER had a reaction like this. Required medical attention to stop and treat the negative effects of the mask.

I would love to be able to submit this with zero stars. I ordered these masks and after the second mask I used I had a severe and extremely serious and life threatening allergy attack. I ended up hospitalized for a week with iv steroids and antibiotics to try to get rid of the allergic reaction. I could have died if I hadn’t gone to the hospital when it got really bad. PLEASE FOR YOUR OWN HEALTH AND SAFETY DO NOT BUY THESE MASKS

avis.titre: Severe skin irritation DO NOT BUY
avis.texte: Ok so don’t buy I got a severe skin rash after using the shea butter one I put it on before bed and woke up at 2 am with some serious itching and washed my face for it to look like this. I’ve taken antihistamines and had to put Benadryl on my face basically and it still itches and hurts. I it thought was Korean face masks they’re not they’re from china it’s not worth your skin. I’ve had to cancel plans because my face hurts too much.

Horrible experience. My daughter had a bad allergic reaction to the honey sheet mask (odd since honey is supposed to be soothing!) Not sure if it was a bad batch but she uses all sort of skin care products and sheet masks and has NEVER had a reaction like this.
I literally got the box and opened it to only find 13 masks when there should be 28! VERY DISAPPOINTING!! Will not order ever again!!

This is a set of 14 different facial sheet masks. It's a budget way to try out sheet masks and would make a great gift set for a novice user. At the current price of around $9, it works out to be about 65 cents per mask. I’ve tried the pomegranate and the oat masks. Both had a good amount of serum, enough that there was plenty to rub in after 20 minutes and have enough left for my hands and feet too. My skin felt hydrated and cool after use. There are some ingredients that may not be best for folks with sensitive skin such as methylparabens and added fragrance. I'm also a little concerned about the colloidal silver since there seems to be some controversy about whether it's a good idea or not. I assume that there is not very much since it seems to be low on the ingredient list. I plan to space these masks out with others and I only use 1 or 2 masks a week so it should be fine but I will not be using these daily.

Love the different ingredients in the masks and that each of the masks is labeled with the effect such as “calming” or “hydrating”. Super fun for sleepovers, bachelorette parties or baby showers. The masks are easy to use and last a long time. 14 different combinations of ingredients, two of each mask. My skin is not sensitive but I do appreciate that these masks are fine for sensitive skin. The mask is tricky to apply because the wet paper tissue mask sticks together. The mask fits pretty well and I can even walk around with the mask on with minimal slippage. Once I have the paper mask in place I squeeze the rest of the clear liquid from the bag the mask came in and spread the liquid on my face and neck. The honey mask liquid is clear and odorless.

This 14-pack of sheet masks from KONEUK is very easy to use and quite nice at only 65 cents per mask. They're a good treat for tired thirsty skin and there's a decent variety of them to cycle through so your face is left nice and hydrated. Because these are budget masks, the ingredients list is not as good as high-end masks but they are still a very relaxing spa experience. My favourite mask was the sake one as it felt soothing on my skin. :) I think if you're just looking for hydrating and jot something super specific out of your sheet masks, this is a really good option as the price is a great value!

avis.titre: 28 Pack Sheet Face Masks Skincare, Hydrating Suitable for Sensitive Skin Skincare All Skin Types
avis.texte: A nice few minutes of self-care. These masks have a cooling, soothing effect, and are lightly hydrating. They're on the smaller side though and don't go all the way up my forehead, so that could be improved. Scent is nice (pomegranate is lovely!) and not overwhelming. The 28-count box is compact and comes with 2 masks of each scent
Son buenas, refrescan el rostro. En la foto tenía puesta la mascarilla de chamomile.
For glowing skin❤️ I love it for affordable Price 😉 I bought 2 boxes 😊

I really like this product! It makes my skin more moisturized and smooth. I bought it because it was a good deal and many people recommended it. The first time I tried it, my skin felt soft, smooth, and not dry at all. The quality is great, and the price is reasonable. Now, I usually use it once or twice a week. The mask smells amazing, and I love it so much. I would definitely buy more!
I bought this product for my daughter. It brings a lot of quantities for the very modest price, which ends up making this product perfect.
Great for sensitive, dry skin. Leaves your skin feeling fresh and supple. Its a sheet masks soaked in a thick serum.
Really good product, my skin is so shiny and smooth, I love it🥰
I had to try it after waxing is really relaxing and cold feeling I really like it
There is no notice of any kind if it hurtful to your health. As a heart patient I am concerned to use it. Without any medical information.
